dedupe_keys.name: indec argentina censo 2022 definitive result tables on dwellings and services water sanitation fuel internet and redatam database to census radius

description: INDEC publishes the definitive results of Argentina's 2022 National Census of Population, Households and Dwellings on the census website, with thematic reports in PDF, national tables in XLSX and a results page for each of the 24 jurisdictions (the city of Buenos Aires and 23 provinces). The national housing tables give the population in private dwellings by predominant wall material, source of water, location of the bathroom or latrine, fuel used for cooking, number of bathrooms, tenure and internet access at home, and a report covers housing conditions of people, households and dwellings, with another on a household material deprivation index. A REDATAM database of private dwellings lets users tabulate the census down to census fraction and radius. It was the first census in Argentina with a digital questionnaire alongside paper enumeration. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF downloads and an online REDATAM portal. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the census site sends an incomplete certificate chain (strict clients need the Sectigo intermediate from its AIA address), the REDATAM portal is interactive, and boundaries for fractions and radii come from the separate geostatistical portal. Simulation uses: water, sanitation and cooking fuel service gaps and building materials for exposure, energy and water planning at small-area level. Related records: IPUMS International and the Brazil census tract aggregates.
